assertion: More than three-quarters of adults without college degrees couldn't correctly estimate the price of a public four-year institution within $5,000.
reason: Lumina-Gallup: 23% within $5,000, so 77% not. Note the survey asked about annual net cost after grants at in-state public colleges (2024).

assertion: Most Americans also think that colleges are overpriced, with nearly two-thirds saying four-year institutions are unaffordable, a Gallup survey found.
inaccuracy: Claim says two-thirds call four-year colleges 'unaffordable'; Gallup says 63% rate them as doing a poor job providing an affordable education.

assertion: Public confusion about how much they actually cost after discounts and financial aid is helping drive a near-record-low confidence in higher education.
inaccuracy: Claim says confusion over net cost drives low confidence; Gallup (38% confident vs 57% in 2015) cites high cost (30%) and politics (31%) as reasons, and does not measure confusion.

assertion: Nearly 70 percent of students and parents think the financial aid process is partly or completely confusing, according to a separate survey by the Strada Education Foundation.
reason: Strada page says aid and costs are confusing and 77% believe college is unaffordable; the 70% figure was not found in the page text.
measure: survey students parents financial aid process confusing
why_no_page: Primary Strada page was read and had no 70% figure; no alternate copy located.

assertion: At 445 colleges and universities of all kinds, not a single student now pays the advertised price, according to a Hechinger Report analysis of federal data. At private, nonprofit four-year universities and colleges, fewer than 1 in 5 families pay that amount.
reason: Hechinger's own analysis; warehouse carries net price (edu.college_scorecard) but no share paying sticker, and the methodology is not in the piece. NCES Digest net price table is context only.
measure: college net price sticker price institutional grant aid percent receiving
why_no_page: No off-site page publishes the 445 figure; NCES Digest table 331.30 was fetched but has no share-paying-sticker measure.
